name: asthenosphere
description: Asthenosphere: an open computational logistics lab for any city. OSM road networks with grade and energy costs, vehicle routing (PyVRP, OR-Tools), AMPL-style optimisation (Gurobi, CPLEX, HiGHS), and Grasshopper data-tree modelling and debugging for Rhino 8, exposed as an MCP server and as Grasshopper Hops components.
